workflow.name: PILLAR LIKHA Digitization Pipeline
workflow.revision: v2.1 (2026-08-09): module-isolated workflow definition (split edition); standalone SKU in both directions; L1 export per docs/INTERCHANGE-SPEC.md

agents.name: Ingestor
agents.description: Validates uploads, computes file hashes, stores raw file records

agents.name: OCR Extractor
agents.description: Extracts text from PDFs/images via module-owned OpenRouter wrapper

agents.name: Metadata Parser
agents.description: Parses ordinance number, series year, title, section count

agents.name: Subject Classifier
agents.description: Suggests subject categories with confidence scores

agents.name: Legal Validator
agents.description: Flags low-confidence extractions; raises HITL gates

agents.name: Archiver
agents.description: Publishes verified records and updates the BM25 index

callbacks.onAgentStart: Set agent status to 'processing'; apply glow class + animate-pulse-glow
callbacks.onAgentComplete: Set status to 'completed'; show output preview; if output.hitlRequired then set status to 'hitl' and pause
callbacks.onHitlRequired: Pause pipeline; add rose-bordered HITL card to activity feed with Review/Confirm/Edit actions
callbacks.onHumanDecision: Resume pipeline (confirm/edit) or terminate branch (reject); persist decision to agent_decisions
callbacks.onPipelineComplete: Set isProcessing=false; glow output icon; add success activity
callbacks.onError: Set status to 'error'; log error; offer retry once then escalate to HITL

data_rules: File hash computed before OCR for duplicate detection
OCR: google/gemini-2.5-flash for PDFs, qwen/qwen3.7-plus for images, temperature 0
Metadata extraction returns structured JSON with per-field confidence
Classifier maps subjects to Code Titles/Chapters taxonomy
Archiver runs only after human confirmation; edits are logged
All reads/writes target LIKHA-owned tables only (archived_ordinances, classifications, amendment_links, agent_decisions module-scoped rows)
L1 interchange export (POST /api/likha/export-package) follows docs/INTERCHANGE-SPEC.md exactly
exception_rules: Duplicate file hash -> warning; skip OCR; surface existing record
OCR timeout >60s -> error; retry once; then HITL
Missing ordinance number -> HITL gate with manual entry
Classification confidence <0.6 -> HITL gate with override dropdown

pipeline_layout.input_bookend: Brain icon, cyan glow when processing
pipeline_layout.output_bookend: Database icon, green glow on completion

activity_feed.empty_state: No activities yet. Start a pipeline to see results.
